review_notes: No printed page number, no running header, no table title on this page — the column-header row is the first thing printed. printed_page 423 inferred from printed_page = scan − 3.

These are the same 15 rows as scan 425, continued rightwards: row n here belongs to the ዓመተ ምሕረት in row n of scan 425 (row 1 = ፪ሺ፩ … row 15 = ፪ሺ፲፭). The three pages 425/426/427 together form ONE table of 15 rows × 17 columns.

Every cell is internally consistent (ሆሣዕና = ትንሣኤ − ፯, ስቅለት = ትንሣኤ − ፪, ደብረ ዘይት = ትንሣኤ − ፳፰, ዓቢይ ጾም = ጾመ ነነዌ + ፲፬), which was used to settle the handful of ፮/፯ and ፬/፭ glyphs that are indistinguishable at this scan quality.
